result:
Fixed `scenario.json` in place.

What changed: the action is now a description update on the same target hub instead of toggling AI features. The request reads "Update the description of the Atlas Onboarding hub created on March 4 whose description mentions vendor contracts to …", the write is `PUT /hubs/9101` with the new `description`, and `written` is now `box_hubs.description`. Seed, conditions, query, and all four decoys are unchanged — the description condition still refers to the current (pre-write) text, and the quoted new text is only the action payload.

Why: the replica accepted the `is_ai_enabled` write but persisted nothing to `box_hubs`, so I switched to a core documented field (`description`) on the same endpoint rather than guessing at other tables or endpoints.
